note: Hand-compiled public strategic infrastructure register from geopolitics_infra_projects.csv.

projects.name: Vadhavan Port
projects.detail: India's deepest greenfield container port, being built at Dahanu at an estimated cost of roughly Rs 76,000 crore; planned to rank among the world's top-10 container ports.

projects.name: Great Nicobar International Container Transshipment Terminal
projects.detail: A strategic transshipment hub positioned near the Malacca Strait shipping lanes, part of the wider Great Nicobar Island development plan.

projects.name: Chabahar Port (Shahid Beheshti Terminal)
projects.detail: An India-operated terminal giving India overland access to Afghanistan and Central Asia that bypasses Pakistan, under a long-term operating pact with Iran.

projects.name: Sittwe Port & Kaladan Multi-Modal Transit Corridor
projects.detail: An India-built port and transit corridor linking Kolkata to Mizoram via Myanmar, intended to ease Northeast India's connectivity.

projects.name: Trincomalee/Colombo Port Strategic Stake
projects.detail: India-backed investment in Sri Lankan port and energy tank-farm infrastructure, amid competition with China-linked Hambantota and Colombo terminal projects.

projects.name: Agalega Islands Airstrip & Jetty
projects.detail: An India-funded airstrip and jetty upgrade supporting Indian Ocean maritime-domain-awareness cooperation with Mauritius.

projects.name: Sagarmala Port Modernization Programme
projects.detail: A national umbrella programme to modernize ports, port connectivity, and coastal economic zones across India.

projects.name: Mumbai Trans Harbour Link (Atal Setu)
projects.detail: India's longest sea bridge, linking Mumbai to Navi Mumbai and easing access to the JNPT container-port corridor.

projects.name: INS Visakhapatnam-class Destroyers (Project 15B)
projects.detail: An indigenous guided-missile destroyer class built at Mazagon Dock; several units are commissioned with the remainder still in build.

projects.name: P-75I Submarine Programme
projects.detail: A follow-on conventional-submarine programme under India's Strategic Partnership model, involving technology transfer from a foreign OEM.
